label: KBS-SK-2005-PASTORAL-LETTER
full_name: Pastiersky list Konferencie biskupov Slovenska o gestách a držaní tela počas slávenia svätej omše
read_at_mass: Sunday, 7 August 2005 (First Sunday of the month; in force from this date)
source_file_note: Not downloaded — kbs.sk not accessible from current network. The companion 'Smernice' document (kbs-2005-directives_gestures) contains the binding norms.
relation: Companion document to kbs-2005-gestures-directives. The pastoral letter explains the theology of liturgical posture (standing, sitting, kneeling); the Smernice contain the binding norms.
summary_en: Explains the theological meaning of the three main liturgical postures (standing, sitting, kneeling) and introduces the norms contained in the companion Smernice directive. Standing signifies respect and readiness; sitting indicates listening; kneeling expresses humility and adoration. The letter emphasises that liturgical postures are communal acts of the Church, not private devotions.
